description.en:
GR-3 is Fourier's care-oriented humanoid for interactive companionship and public-facing service research. Its design combines a soft covering, an expressive interface and coordinated body language to make interaction more approachable. The manufacturer's documentation lists a height of 165 cm, a mass of 71 kg and 55 degrees of freedom.

Fourier's Full-Sense Interaction System combines hearing, vision and touch to inform responses during social interaction. The platform also supports physical manipulation, with a stated single-arm payload of up to 3 kg. Its care positioning centers on companionship and engagement; actual services and task behavior depend on the deployed application and operating environment.
